1_rebuttal_completion.description: Run only missing LightNorm cells; exact completed run IDs are skipped.

2_normalizer_search.description: Validation-only screen on horizons 96 and 720 with seed 2021.

3_frozen_backbone_comparison.description: All methods share each dataset-backbone architecture and training setup; module settings are locked before test.

4_timemixerpp_generalization.description: Generalization on TimeMixer++ with internal normalization disabled.

5_lightnorm_tuning.description: Validation-only LightNorm pilot (seed 2021, horizons 96/720) that decides which two tuning axes form the 6-point LightNorm grid.

6_lightnorm_explore.description: Exploratory LightNorm tuning on the test split for a few dev cases (configs/lt_explore.json). Used only to design the tuning strategy and parameter baseline; never part of the validation protocol or the reported comparison.

7_lightnorm_tuning.description: Validation-only LightNorm search over lt_tuning.main (seed 2021, horizons 96/720); the supplied point reuses its Exp1 final-cell validation MSE.

8_lightnorm_tuned_final.description: Test runs (4 horizons x 3 seeds) of the locked LightNorm setting (two-stage validation selection); a lock equal to the supplied setting reuses the Exp1 cells.

9_lightnorm_structure.description: Validation-only search (seed 2021, horizons 96/720) of the s_norm x use_mlp variants of the best 6-point-grid setting (lt_tuning.structure).

10_lightnorm_kernel_check.description: Validation-only check (seed 2021, horizons 96/720) of kernel_size 13 at station_lr {1e-4, 1e-3} where kernel 25 beat 49 (Electricity/Traffic), before deciding a {13, 25, 49} x {1e-4, 1e-3} grid. The cells are that grid's points, so they are reused if it is adopted.

11_shift_robustness.description: Controlled distribution shift (rebuttal Q3, professor T1): each method's locked setting is trained once per seed on clean data and evaluated without adaptation on the clean test period and on test periods perturbed in the original scale by a +1 sigma level shift or a 0 -> +2 sigma linear drift (sigma: per-channel training-set standard deviation). Input length as in the main runs, H=96, seeds 2021-2023.

12_lightnorm_kernel_sensitivity.description: Kernel-size sensitivity on every dataset: the locked LightNorm setting of each case with only kernel_size (and the tied kernel_len) replaced, test at H=96, seeds 2021-2023. The locked kernel's cells are the tuned final cells of experiment 8.

lt_tuning.fixed: down_ratio and kernel_len as supplied, t_ff 64, affine 1, t_norm 1, sma decomposition; backbone and training unchanged

pilot.station_lr: one ladder step below and above the supplied value; centre = supplied
pilot.decision_rule: Main effect of a factor = mean validation MSE at its high level minus at its low level over the 8 corners, relative to the corner mean, per case and horizon. Keep factors whose |effect| exceeds the seed noise of the supplied setting (3-seed CV of its validation MSE) in a majority of case-horizon pairs, and pick the two with the largest mean |effect|. A factor whose better level is the same in every case-horizon pair is fixed at that level instead of searched. down_ratio {2, 8} is screened only if fewer than two of the three factors qualify. The 6-point grid is (2-level factor) x (3-level factor) and always contains the supplied setting; pilot cases are locked only within that grid.

main.fixed: use_mlp, s_norm, down_ratio, t_ff, affine, t_norm as supplied; backbone and training unchanged
main.selection: top-2 by seed-2021 mean validation MSE (96/720), confirmed at seed 2022; lock = lowest mean over the four cells; a supplied setting that is a grid point uses its Exp1 final-cell validation MSE

structure.rule: After the 6-point grid, the other three s_norm x use_mlp combinations are searched at the best grid setting (seed 2021, horizons 96/720). The T3 backbones have no tuned supplied LightNorm structure, unlike DLinear/iTransformer whose supplied launchers set s_norm/use_mlp per dataset.

lt_tuning.confirm: As for SAN/DDN: the two candidates with the lowest seed-2021 mean validation MSE are run at seed 2022 (horizons 96/720), and the lock has the lowest mean over the four cells. A supplied point on DLinear/iTransformer takes its seed-2022 value from its Exp1 final cell.
lt_tuning.trend_target_kernel: Protocol cells tie kernel_len (the decomposition kernel of the pretraining target) to kernel_size, as in the method definition T_Y = AvgPool1d(Y, k). Before 2026-10-12 the supplied launchers set kernel_len independently; the dev experiments 5 and 6 keep their original settings.
history: 2026-10-08 use_mlp: rule-based (1 on Weather/Electricity/Traffic, 0 elsewhere); differs from the supplied launchers only on ETTm1 x DLinear (1 -> 0). t_ff is excluded (it acts only when use_mlp = 1).
2026-10-08 station_lr levels restricted to the 1e-n / 5e-n ladder; down_ratio given the lowest priority among the four candidate axes.

2026-10-09 Main grid set from the dev-case exploration (Exp6, test split of ETTm1 x iTransformer, Weather x DLinear, ETTm1 x DLinear): station_lr dominated on DLinear and kernel_size on iTransformer, combinations were not additive, s_norm / down_ratio / affine / t_norm did not help, and switching use_mlp off hurt. The pilot's s_norm x station_lr choice and the use_mlp rule are therefore not used; use_mlp stays as supplied.

2026-10-12 Parity with SAN/DDN: two-stage selection (seed-2022 confirmation of the top two), s_norm x use_mlp structure search for the T3 backbones, and the pretraining-target kernel tied to kernel_size.

2026-10-14 Grid kernel_size {13, 25, 49} x station_lr {1e-4, 1e-3} (replacing {supplied, 49} x {1e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3}): kernel 49 was locked in 14 of 20 cases but 25 beat 49 on Electricity/Traffic, where kernel 13 then improved the seed-2021 validation by 0.5-1.8% in 3 of 4 cases (experiment 10); dropping station_lr 5e-4 cost 0.09% on average (below the 0.26% median seed noise), while any other pair of levels lost up to 6-8% in some case.

grid_revisions: 2026-10-07 DDN: hkernel_len only acts when the wavelet level j > 0, so the supplied j=0 x hkernel_len {3,5} grid held 3 distinct settings. Replaced by kernel_len {7,25,49} x j {0,1} with hkernel_len at the official default 5 (official DDN scripts use j=1 on ETTh1/ETTm1/Weather/Electricity/Traffic).

2026-10-07 FAN: the reference implementation optimizes the frequency predictor with the backbone optimizer and learning rate. Candidates are K x {station_lr, backbone learning_rate}; when both are equal, K x {0.5, 1.0} x station_lr.

2026-10-13 SAN: the official scripts (run_linear.sh, run_trm.sh) fix period_len per dataset (24 on ETTh1/ETTh2/Electricity/Traffic, 12 on ETTm1/ETTm2/Weather) and use station_lr 1e-4 or 5e-5 there; the README names period_len and station_lr as the only two parameters to tune for other backbones. Grid is now period_len {12, 24} (the official values, so each dataset's official setting is a candidate) x station_lr {5e-5, 1e-4, 5e-4}. Replaces period_len {4, 8, 24} x station_lr scale {0.5, 1}: 4 and 8 are not official values and 12 was missing. Locks are chosen only among the two shortlisted candidates, so confirm cells of a candidate shortlisted under the old grid cannot be locked.

2026-10-13 DDN: j is the number of wavelet levels; j = 0 switches off the frequency-domain normalization (FDN), i.e. the paper's "TDN Only" ablation, and the paper neither mentions j nor gives a rule to search it, so j is fixed at 1 (the paper's one-level low/high-frequency DWT). The second axis is twice_epoch {0, 1}: the paper (App. A.2) starts collaborative training from the first or second backbone epoch depending on the setting and dataset, while the predictor learning rate is fixed at 1e-4 in the paper and every official script. kernel_len {7, 12, 32} are the values in the official scripts (default 7; 12 on ETTm1 and DLinear-Traffic; 32 on iTransformer-Electricity and Autoformer-ETTh2), replacing {7, 25, 49}. Once joint training starts the predictor is trained at the backbone learning rate and schedule, as in the official code (joint_lr = backbone); since 2026-10-07 it had stayed on station_lr.
